//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI BENTO TILE sub-component — one bento cell (svelte display/KpiBentoTile.svelte, keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiBento.kpi_bento_tile/1`). The parent kpi-bento.json container defers these tile classes (fixture-ref → here). This is a CLEAN BLOCK fixture: the root element carries the hyphen-joined block class `pa-kpi-bento-tile` (NOT a `pa-kpi-bento__tile` element of the container block), and its parts are flat sub-elements `pa-kpi-bento-tile__label/__delta/__value/__num/__unit`. Modifiers on the block: the five sentiment accents (--positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong/--down-strong, caught by the block-modifier reverse check and produced by the `variant` enum) plus --hero (the oversized primary cell, produced by the `isHero` bool). The sentiment DEFAULT (no variant) emits NO modifier class — the SCSS seeds `--pa-kpi-accent: var(--pa-positive)` on the bare tile, so both wrappers must guard the modifier (svelte `if (variant)`, keen `{…, v != nil}`) and NOT emit a phantom `--positive`. SCOPE: label + delta + value (prefix/num/unit) — the cells both wrappers emit identically pre-JS-hook. The full-bleed sparkline layer (__chart / __chart-svg) is DEFERRED as acknowledged prose: it hosts an author-supplied SVG fed through a slot the dumpers pass as plain text, and the two wrappers' chart SSR shells diverge (svelte wraps the slot in `use:kpiSparklineDots`, keen iterates the :chart slot list) — forcing a scenario through the chart would diff chart plumbing, not the tile contract. The detail popover (KpiDetailPopover / kpi_detail) is also out of this slice (its own kpi-detail fragment fixture). Authored from snippets/kpi.html (BENTO section) + _kpi-bento.scss. Same clean-block fragment model as timeline-item.json; same chart-deferral stance the parent container took.
goldenConventions: Root element is a <div class="pa-kpi-bento-tile …">. __label ALWAYS renders (both wrappers emit it unconditionally; empty when no label). __delta renders only when a delta value is supplied. __value is the focal wrapper holding, in document order, an optional __unit prefix span, the __num span, and an optional __unit suffix span (snippets/kpi.html bento tile). The default sentiment emits no modifier class; --hero and the five sentiment variants are the only block modifiers. The detail popover + the sparkline __chart/__chart-svg layer are deferred (see `deferred`). Class-token + attribute order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

deferred.//: The full-bleed sparkline layer — hosts an author-supplied SVG fed via a slot the dumpers pass as plain TEXT, and the two wrappers' chart SSR shells diverge (svelte wraps it in a `use:kpiSparklineDots` host, keen iterates the :chart slot). Diffing it would test chart plumbing, not the tile contract — acknowledged out-of-scope prose (same stance the parent kpi-bento.json container took for the whole tile).
deferred.pa-kpi-bento-tile__chart: full-bleed faint sparkline layer — hosts a slot-fed SVG (plain text through the dumpers); chart SSR shells diverge between wrappers — deferred
deferred.pa-kpi-bento-tile__chart-svg: SVG host span inside __chart — part of the deferred chart layer

propsVocabulary.variant: sentiment accent — pa-kpi-bento-tile--{variant}; cascades the delta/sparkline colour via --pa-kpi-accent. Default (nil) emits NO modifier (SCSS seeds --pa-positive on the bare tile). svelte `variant`, keen `variant`.
propsVocabulary.isHero: the oversized primary cell (first child) — pa-kpi-bento-tile--hero; bumps value font-size + chart height. svelte `isHero`, keen `is_hero`.
propsVocabulary.labelText: uppercase mono name cell — pa-kpi-bento-tile__label (always rendered). svelte `labelText`, keen `label_text`.
propsVocabulary.deltaText: Δ% chip — pa-kpi-bento-tile__delta (rendered only when set). svelte `deltaText`, keen `delta_text`.
propsVocabulary.valueText: focal number — pa-kpi-bento-tile__num inside the __value wrapper. svelte `valueText`, keen `value_text`.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit/affix suffix — pa-kpi-bento-tile__unit after the number. svelte `unit`, keen `unit_text`.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix — pa-kpi-bento-tile__unit before the number. svelte `prefix`, keen `prefix_text`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the tile (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.
